* 1. -main
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: boot/-main
:FILE: src/graphden/executor_runtime/core.clj
:LINE: 187
:MINS: 1.1
:END:

The JVM entry point starts the [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][Integrant]] component system, installs a shutdown hook, optionally opens nREPL, then keeps the process alive. The HTTP server starts separately through service [[file:glossary.org::#term/reconciliation][reconciliation]]; ~-main~ does not itself handle requests.

* 2. boot!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: boot/boot!
:FILE: src/graphden/executor_runtime/core.clj
:LINE: 167
:MINS: 1.8
:END:

Starts the system and, on failure, halts components that already initialized before exiting with an error. [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][Integrant]] does not automatically halt a partially initialized system, so this cleanup prevents surviving threads from keeping a failed startup alive.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/executor_runtime/core.clj::(defn boot!][src/graphden/executor_runtime/core.clj:167]]

* 3. read-config
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: boot/read-config
:FILE: src/graphden/system/config.clj
:LINE: 83
:MINS: 1.7
:END:

Reads profile configuration with Aero, then merges [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addon]] fragments listed in ~GRAPHDEN_ADDON_CONFIGS~. [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][Addons]] can replace or add [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][Integrant]] component keys without changing core configuration files. With no [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addons]], the core configuration is used unchanged. See [[file:../../../docs/TENANCY_SEAM.md][addon configuration]].

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/system/config.clj::(defn read-config][src/graphden/system/config.clj:83]]

* 5. postgres
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: boot/postgres
:FILE: src/graphden/system/init/storage.clj
:LINE: 110
:MINS: 1.1
:END:

Opens the PostgreSQL connection pool and initializes the declared schema. An optional ~:datasource-wrap~ lets the tenancy [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addon]] attach organisation context to each connection for row-level security. The versioned-storage component subsequently wraps this storage.

* 7. context
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: boot/context
:FILE: src/graphden/system/init/exec.clj
:LINE: 136
:MINS: 6.7

Builds the base [[file:glossary.org::#term/context][execution context]], including [[file:glossary.org::#term/auth][authentication]], request scoping, execution checks, vault access, notifications, and [[file:glossary.org::#term/fleet][fleet]] forwarding. Branch-specific contexts are derived later. ~:compile-storage~ may provide a privileged structural graph view; it must not be confused with organisation-scoped application data reads.

* 8. compiled-registry
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: boot/compiled-registry
:FILE: src/graphden/system/init/exec.clj

:MINS: 0.9

Compiles the graph before serving the first request so the base context starts with a populated [[file:glossary.org::#term/compiled-registry][compiled registry]]. Subsequent graph changes can still invalidate or update it; this startup compilation does not make the registry permanent.

* 9. dispatch-first
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: boot/dispatch-first
:FILE: src/graphden/system/route_collection.clj
:LINE: 91
:MINS: 1.1
:END:

Tries optional registered [[file:glossary.org::#term/ring][Ring]] routers in order. A router returns nil to let the next router handle the request; when none handles it, the application router is used. Packages and [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addons]] can register routes without changing the core handler chain.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/system/route_collection.clj::(defn dispatch-first][src/graphden/system/route_collection.clj:91]]

Compares literal ~/api/*~ and ~/partials/*~ paths in editor JavaScript with the actual router during boot. A missing route prevents startup. This catches changes to those statically discoverable paths; dynamically constructed URLs still need their own tests.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/system/api_url_drift.clj::(defn check-router!][src/graphden/system/api_url_drift.clj:285]]

* 11. -main
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: boot/-main~2
:FILE: src/graphden/cli.clj
:LINE: 304
:MINS: 1.6
:END:

The CLI is a second entry point using the same application artifact. It transfers and compares graph branches through authenticated HTTP APIs using export, import, diff, push, and pull. It does not require direct database access.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/cli.clj::(defn -main][src/graphden/cli.clj:304]]

* 12. register-checkpoint-hooks!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: boot/register-checkpoint-hooks!
:FILE: src/graphden/crac.clj
:LINE: 202
:MINS: 1.3
:END:

Registers optional [[file:glossary.org::#term/checkpoint][CRaC]] [[file:glossary.org::#term/checkpoint][checkpoint/restore]] hooks. Before a [[file:glossary.org::#term/checkpoint][checkpoint]], schedulers pause and open connections and listeners close; restore resumes them. These hooks do nothing on an ordinary JVM. See [[file:../../../docs/FLEET_RFC.md][fleet checkpoint design]] and ~development/crac/~.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crac.clj::(defn register-checkpoint-hooks!][src/graphden/crac.clj:202]]
